scripts.lint:fix:all: npm run lint:fix && node scripts/fix-unused-vars.js && npm run lint:fix
scripts.lint:cleanup: npm run lint:fix && node scripts/fix-unused-vars.js && npm run prettier:write
scripts.ci:lint-prettier: npm run prettier:check && npm run lint
scripts.ios:dev: npm run env:dev && bash scripts/with-brew-ruby.sh react-native run-ios --scheme "Birdzy-Dev" --mode "Debug-Dev"
scripts.ios:prod: npm run env:prod && bash scripts/with-brew-ruby.sh react-native run-ios --scheme "Birdzy" --mode "Debug"
scripts.ios:build:dev: npm run env:dev && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Birdzy.xcworkspace -scheme Birdzy-Dev -configuration Release-Dev -sdk iphoneos archive -archivePath build/Birdzy-Dev.xcarchive
scripts.ios:build:prod: npm run env:prod && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Birdzy.xcworkspace -scheme Birdzy -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos archive -archivePath build/Birdzy.xcarchive
scripts.android:build:dev:apk: npm run env:dev && npm run android:check:dev && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDevRelease
scripts.android:build:dev:aab: npm run env:dev && npm run android:check:dev && cd android && ./gradlew bundleDevRelease
scripts.android:build:prod:apk: npm run env:prod && npm run android:check:prod && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProdRelease
scripts.android:build:prod:aab: npm run env:prod && npm run android:check:prod && cd android && ./gradlew bundleProdRelease
scripts.android:clean:full: cd android && rm -rf app/.cxx app/build build .gradle && ./gradlew clean
scripts.ios:clean: bash scripts/with-brew-ruby.sh bash -c 'cd ios && rm -rf Pods Podfile.lock && bundle exec pod deintegrate && bundle exec pod install'
scripts.pod:install: bash scripts/with-brew-ruby.sh bash -c 'cd ios && bundle exec pod install'
scripts.pod:update: bash scripts/with-brew-ruby.sh bash -c 'cd ios && bundle exec pod update'
scripts.firebase:deploy:dev: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use dev && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy
scripts.firebase:deploy:prod: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use prod && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy
scripts.firebase:deploy:all: npm run firebase:deploy:dev && npm run firebase:deploy:prod
scripts.firebase:deploy:dev:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use dev && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:rules,storage
scripts.firebase:deploy:prod:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use prod && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:rules,storage
scripts.firebase:deploy:all:rules: npm run firebase:deploy:dev:rules && npm run firebase:deploy:prod:rules
scripts.firebase:deploy:dev:indexes: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use dev && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:indexes
scripts.firebase:deploy:prod:indexes: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use prod && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:indexes
scripts.remoteconfig:pull:dev: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use dev && npx -y firebase-tools@latest remoteconfig:get -o remoteconfig.template.json
scripts.remoteconfig:pull:prod: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use prod && npx -y firebase-tools@latest remoteconfig:get -o remoteconfig.template.json
scripts.remoteconfig:push:dev: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use dev && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only remoteconfig
scripts.remoteconfig:push:prod: npx -y firebase-tools@latest use prod && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only remoteconfig
scripts.remoteconfig:push:all: npm run remoteconfig:push:dev && npm run remoteconfig:push:prod
